seoTitle: LaTeX to MathML Converter with Live Preview
metaDescription: Convert LaTeX math to MathML that browsers draw natively: fractions, roots, sums, scripts, matrices, cases. Free, offline.
intro: Turns LaTeX math into MathML and previews it with the browser's own MathML renderer.
why:
MathML is part of the web platform and current browsers draw it without a library. Writing it by hand is long, while LaTeX is short.

This converter parses a subset of LaTeX math: fractions, roots, sub and superscripts, big operators with limits, Greek letters, common symbols, accents, text and font commands, left and right delimiters, and matrix and cases environments. Anything outside that list raises a clear error rather than printing wrong output. It is not KaTeX or MathJax, and it has no SVG export.
howTo: Type or paste LaTeX math, with a blank line between formulas.
Copy the MathML into your HTML.
Fix any unsupported command named in the error.
